subject.title: feat(telegram): send voice typing cue before transcription

question: Should this PR require live Telegram proof before merge, or may maintainers intentionally accept the source-ordering evidence for this visible typing-cue change?
rationale: The code path and focused tests support the ordering change, but repository Telegram policy requires real Telegram proof for transport-visible behavior and only maintainers can override that proof bar.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, bot log, live output, or equivalent artifact shows the cue before transcription or the agent reply on the rebased head.

options.title: Accept source-ordering risk
options.body: Maintainers can merge based on source ordering and tests, but they own the risk that Telegram clients still do not visibly show the cue soon enough.

options.title: Pause until branch refresh
options.body: Wait for the contributor to rebase the conflicting branch first, then reassess proof and merge readiness on the refreshed head.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, bot log, live output, or equivalent artifact shows the cue before transcription or the agent reply on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof-standard and merge-readiness decision is broader than the narrow code path, and steipete has adjacent Telegram context history plus repository routing context.
